3.30 COVENS OF UMBRA - launches Fri 13 Nov 11:00 PST = 21:00 SA time

WHAT CHANGED (reveal, patch notes still to come)
- Scarabs are GONE. Threads of Creation go in the map device instead (up to 3 mechanics per map, up to 8 Threads each). Atlas regions + rebuilt Atlas tree also add mechanics.
- League mechanic: kill covenites, pick Fates, invoke up to 3 on the area boss (campaign AND maps) for more loot and a harder fight. Bosses drop Viscera for your Wickerman. Grim Fates on pinnacle bosses drop Pinnacle Viscera.
- Mirage is core and can cover the whole map. Mechanics next to each other interact.
- Loot rework: magic/rare items drop with tiers (T5 = best). T5 Simplex Amulets / Cord Belts and FRACTURED magic items can drop from normal content.
- Map/monster rarity now also boosts currency, div cards, gems and uniques.
- Incursion: Atziri replaces the Omnitect, items can be corrupted a SECOND time, she can drop a Soul Core.
- Harvest: Sacred Grove removed, Harvest is in maps now. Bestiary: no yellow beasts needed for recipes.
- Betrayal: veiled jewels, fractured veiled mods. Ultimatum: double down. Expedition: Gwennen gamble.

WEEK 1 RULES
1. Never sit on chaos. Swap spare chaos to divines or the High watchlist items on day 1-3.
2. Speed matters: day 2 buys made roughly double what day 3 buys made last league.
3. Most items lose value in week 1. Only buy what is on the list.
4. Sell anything in the Sell group the moment it drops.

NEW-LEAGUE FLIPS (no history yet, watch from hour 1)
- Threads of Creation: everyone needs them for maps now. Expect wild early prices; buy the cheap types of whatever mechanic goes meta, sell into the rush.
- Viscera: Greater and Pinnacle Viscera will be the chase items. Sell early drops while few exist, unless one is a big upgrade for Winter Orb.
- Soul Cores from Atziri: new, price unknown, sell the first ones.
- Price-check every tier 4/5 unidentified magic/rare item, especially Simplex Amulets and Cord Belts.

DAY BY DAY
Day 1-2 (campaign): invoke Fates on campaign bosses for early Viscera, level meta gems in spare sockets, price-check every base and T4/T5 drop, sell drops right away.
Day 3-5: pick an Atlas region for a mechanic you like and farm it. Buy Threads only once you see what is profitable. Vaal/sell levelled gems.
Day 5-7: take profit on the Flip group. Keep the High group into week 2.

SPLIT (from day 2)
40% High watchlist basket
20% Flip group (sell in week 1)
40% divines (gear, Threads, Atlas)

BUILD: Winter Orb Elementalist (backup: LA Deadeye for clear, Cold Dot Occultist for bossing)
